statement:
∀ (B : Set ℝ) (ρ η : ℝ), B.Nonempty → 0 ≤ ρ → 0 < η →
  Metric.ediam B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ →
  ∃ J : Set ℝ, IsOpen J ∧ B ⊆ J ∧ MeasureTheory.volume J ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ + η)
proof:
classical
  intro B ρ η hB hρ hη hd
  have hb : Bornology.IsBounded B := Metric.isBounded_iff_ediam_ne_top.mpr
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hd)
  let a := sInf B
  let b := sSup B
  have hlen : b - a ≤ ρ := by
    rw [← Real.diam_eq hb]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hρ hd
  refine ⟨Set.Ioo (a - η/2) (b + η/2), isOpen_Ioo, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx' := hb.subset_Icc_sInf_sSup hx
    constructor <;> dsimp [a,b] at * <;> linarith [hx'.1,hx'.2]
  · rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    linarith

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)),
  Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
      0 ≤ dimH E ∧
        dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
          dimH E < ∞ ∧ (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GDContent s δ E < ∞) ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0) →
    ((∀ (x y : GDVec n) (t u : ℝ), dist (GDPoint x t) (GDPoint y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
        ∀ (z : GDVec (n + 1)), ∃ x t, z = GDPoint x t) →
      ∀ (B : Set ℝ) (ρ η : ℝ),
        B.Nonempty →
          0 ≤ ρ →
            0 < η →
              Metric.ediam B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ →
                ∃ J, IsOpen J ∧ B ⊆ J ∧ MeasureTheory.volume J ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ + η)
